name: CUORE detector
notes: The cited source for this placement (checked 2026-09-17) only confirms 'INFN's Gran Sasso National Laboratory' generally, not the Hall A designation specifically. CUORE's presence in Hall A is well established in the literature (e.g. CUORE cryostat papers), but no directly fetchable primary or official source stating 'Hall A' verbatim for CUORE was found, so the placement's confidence is 'approximate' rather than 'verified'.

placements.note: The cited source states the general LNGS location, not the Hall A designation; see the detector notes.
placements.quote: operated at INFN's Gran Sasso National Laboratory

isotope.quote: The CUORE experiment searches for 0νββ of 130Te

isotope_mass.note: The article gives the crystal mass as "approximately 0.8 tonnes"; other secondary literature describes the full detector as reaching the "tonne mass scale" (including structural material); this was not independently re-verified.
isotope_mass.quote: 988 crystals of tellurium dioxide ... approximately 0.8 tonnes

summary.plain: 988 crystals of tellurium dioxide, cooled to a fraction of a degree above absolute zero, arranged in towers inside a giant refrigerator under an Italian mountain.
summary.technical: Array of 988 TeO2 bolometric crystals (19 towers, ~0.8 t crystal mass) operated at ~10 mK in a dedicated cryostat in LNGS Hall A.

technology.quote: a tonne-scale cryogenic calorimeter operated at milli-kelvin temperatures
